data.body: WAIVER: DD3 (post-rollback CI run evidence) is not verifiable post-cutover. The legacy bridge workflow files (inbound-bridge.yml, outbound-bridge.yml) were removed in task 6cbb as part of the cutover commit. DD3 was designed for pre-cutover validation timing; with workflows deleted and the reconciler now active, live CI re-execution against the old paths is not feasible. The rollback playbook (rollback-bridge-cutover.sh), dryrun harness (dryrun-bridge-rollback-in-worktree.sh), and both test suites (test-rollback-bridge-cutover.sh 5/5, test-rollback-dryrun-e2e.sh 6/6) are verified. Story closed under waiver: criterion superseded by post-cutover state.
